summary: This directory defines the input data structures required to initiate and perform analysis on package concepts, encapsulating the metadata, file structure, API surfaces, and dependency graphs necessary for conceptual evaluation.
responsibilities: Define the schema for package concept input data
Model the structure of package metadata and internal architecture
Represent dependency information for concept analysis
relationships: The PackageConceptInput aggregates package metadata and dependency data to define the scope of analysis.
The directory structure and public API definitions are modeled as key components of the input object used for evaluating package concepts.
designDecisions: Usage of interfaces to enforce a strict contract for input data
Aggregation of structural and dependency data into a single input entry point
